definitions.explanation: Being older than someone else; a person who is older.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧{年上|としうえ}だ。
examples.english: He is three years older than me.

examples.japanese: {年上|としうえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: To use polite language with older people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{年上|としうえ}です。
examples.english: My wife is older than me.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧ (age, year) + ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧ (above) → above in years = older

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜より{年上|としうえ} - older than ~
- {年上|としうえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ - older person
- ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧{年上|としうえ} - three years older

USAGE:
Used to describe age relationships between people. Important in Japanese culture where age often determines social hierarchy and language use.

NOTE ON RELATIONSHIPS:
{年上|としうえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧/⟦{彼氏|かれし}→彼氏：06456_kareshi⟧ often refers to a romantic partner who is older, sometimes significantly so.
